RETENTION INCENTIVE PROGRAM
Ref: (a) RESPERS M-1001.5
(b) 37 U.S.C.
(c) DoD Instruction 1304.34 of 11 July 2016
(d) DoD Instruction 6000.13 of 3 May 2016
Encl: (I) Fiscal Year 2027 SELRES Officer Recruiting and Retention Incentive Eligibility
Tables
1. Purpose. The Department of the Navy (DoN) authorizes monetary incentives for Selected
Reserve (SELRES) officers that may be used as a recruiting or retention tool to maintain
readiness of the Reserve Component (RC). The officer affiliation, accession, and retention
bonuses target certain SELRES officer pay grades in specific designators as outlined in enclosure
(1 ). This notice is effective as of l October 2026.
2. Policy. All program policies contained in reference ( a), articles 1100-010 and 11 00-030,
remain in effect unless amended or amplified in this notice. These articles provide guidance on
responsibilities for SELRES personnel, Navy Reserve Activities (NRA), and echelon 4
commands and amplifying information on officer incentives such as, service obligation,
eligibility, and application procedures.
3. Scope and Applicabilitv. This notice applies to all Navy officer SELRES personnel.
4. Tenns. Incentives outlined within this policy are governed by references (a) through (d).
5. Timeline. Commander, Navy Reserve Forces Command (N 112) will adjudicate, on a case­
by-case basis, requests to grandfather existing quotas, letters, or contracts impacted by award
reductions or eliminations. This grandfathering provision is valid for 30 days from the effective
date in paragraph I. All incentives will be processed based on the policy in effect at the time of
the member's accession, affiliation, or renewal of oath.
a. Accordingly, the applicable bonus agreement should be executed at the time of accession,
affiliation, or renewal of oath as applicable.
b. NRAs are responsible for ensuring incentive agreements are executed or declined by the
SELRES member within 90 days after the member's first inactive duty training (IDT) period.

Per reference (a), members declining to accept the bonus will sign a declination NAVPERS
1070/613 Administrative Remarks. The NRA will process all signed agreements and
declinations within 5 days of receipt.
6. Bonus Payout Structure. Bonuses will be paid according to the eligibility tables in enclosure
(1 ). All payments are taxable.
a. Officer accession bonuses are paid as a Jump sum for direct commission officer (DCO)
appointments in the Navy Reserve after successful completion of Officer Development School.
b. Officer affiliation bonuses are paid as a lump sum upon affiliation to the Navy Reserve
from Active Component, including completion of initial lDT period, as a Navy Veteran
(NAVET) or Other Service Veteran (OS VET).
c. Eligibility for anniversary payments is contingent upon the member maintaining
satisfactory participation in the designator or specialty for each year of the bonus contract.
7. Final Adjudication Author ity. The Office of the Chief of Naval Operations (OPNA V) N0951
is the final adjudication authority for recruiting and retention incentives for SELRES officers in
the RC. Eligibility, termination, and repayment inquiries will be routed to OPNAV N0951 via
Commander, Navy Reserve Force NJ. This does not include remission or waiver of
indebtedness cases. Any request for remission or waiver of indebtedness wiJI be adjudicated by
proper authority per applicable statute, Department of War regulations, and DoN Guidance.
8. Points of Contact. Members should contact the bonus program coordinator at their respective
NRA. NRAs will direct any execution or policy concerns to their immediate superior in
command's manpower and personnel support representative.
9. Records Management. Records created as a result of this instruction, regardless of the media
and format must be managed per Secretary of the Navy Manual 5210.1 of September 2019.

a. Bonus availability is subject to change based on budget or recruiting attainment
towards approved annual goal. Once a recruiting goal is attained, no further affiliation
bonuses are authorized for that designator.
b. RC accession bonus eligibility requirements as outlined by DoDl 1304.34.
Members initial receipt of a DCO appointment.
c. Retention bonuses may be offered only after existing obligations are fulfilled, with
a minimum of 4 years of completed commissioned service (active or reserve).
Additionally, 12 continuous months of satisfactory drill participation is required.
Members must be serving in the Ready Reserve or have served previously as a
commissioned officer and given an honorable discharge.
d. Information Warfare line officers must complete Infom1ation Warfare Officer
qualifications to be eligible for the retention bonus.
e. YCS is defined as years of commissioned service.
